newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends weaker in line with Aust dlr fall.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends weaker in line with Aust dlr fall.

text.p: U.S. dollar strength and Australian dollar weakness combined to take the New Zealand dollar lower at the close on Tuesday.
The Kiwi finished at US$0.6898/05 and at 68.73 on its Trade-Weighted Index from 0.6926/33 and 68.96 at the open.
There had been a lack of follow-through buying for the Kiwi.
"The buyers were a bit lower down and a few people have been caught a tad long," said one Auckland dealer.
Volume was not heavy, but there was some stop loss activity below US$0.6910. Expected range overnight US$0.6885-0.6925.
Longer term, the Kiwi was expected to be range-bound.
"But bigger picture, I think we can go higher," the dealer said.
